question: Who does claire from mcleods daughters end up with?
text:
Claire McLeod ends up with **Alex Ryan**, but she dies before they get a long-term future together.

- She dated her longtime friend Alex, and they stayed together until her death.[1]
- The two had always had a secret affection for each other, but it only became something more when they travelled to Melbourne together.[1]
- Her daughter Charlotte's father is a different man. Charlotte was born out of an affair with Peter Johnson.[1]
- Claire died at the end of season three.[2] Her car went over a cliff into a canyon.[1]
- Alex had planned to propose when she got back from town.[1] At her funeral, he put the ring he never got the chance to give her on the coffin.[3]

Alex later married Stevie Hall. He was killed in season 8. A large tree branch fell on him.[4]
